title: Define MVP scope: no spec/docs; scope inferred from route surface
impact: Launch criteria cannot be objectively agreed; audit scope is inferred.
remediation: Write README product section listing journeys J1-J5 and declared out-of-scope stubs.

title: Stop app crashing at module load when GEMINI_API_KEY is unset
impact: Any build without the env var white-screens the entire SPA including the login page (top-level throw in bundle: `throw new Error("API_KEY environment variable not set")` with `apiKey:void 0`).
exploit_or_repro: `npx vite build` without .env.local, open dist/index.html -> uncaught Error before React mounts. Probe test 'J1 boot without API key' confirms import() rejects.
remediation: Lazy-initialise GoogleGenAI inside each service function; return a typed 'AI unavailable' error so non-AI journeys work.

title: Implement Save for Script Riter scenarios (button has no handler)
impact: Core editor journey ends in silent no-op; all work lost on reload.
exploit_or_repro: Open Script Riter, click Save -> nothing happens (probe J3 asserts onClick undefined).
remediation: Add save/load via localStorage + JSON export; wire Save button.

title: Implement tournament Register (button has no handler; data hard-coded)
impact: 'Live tournaments' headline feature is a static mock; Register does nothing.
exploit_or_repro: Click Register on an Upcoming tournament -> no state change (probe J4).
remediation: Add registration state (local) with optimistic UI; mark data source as mock until a backend exists.

title: Add a runnable test runner; `npm test` does not exist
impact: Zero executable tests; the sole test file cannot run (jest.mock + @jest/globals, no config).
remediation: Add vitest + jsdom config, `test`/`typecheck` scripts, port GatewayScene.test.tsx to vitest.

title: Existing Gateway test asserts an unimplemented 'bad password' rejection
impact: Test is a false specification; would fail as soon as a runner is added.
exploit_or_repro: Probe J1b: submitting 'operator1'/'password' yields no alert.
remediation: Implement an auth service boundary that returns the asserted failure (or correct the test spec with the owner). Do not delete the test.

title: Make typecheck green: tsc --noEmit exits 2 (12 errors); no lint; no CI
impact: No reproducible green signal exists; regressions are undetectable.
remediation: Add jest-dom type augmentation for vitest; add `typecheck` script and CI workflow running typecheck+test+build.

title: Gemini API key is compiled into the public client bundle
impact: Anyone loading the deployed site can extract the key and bill the owner's Google account.
exploit_or_repro: `grep apiKey dist/assets/*.js` after a keyed build.
remediation: Move Gemini calls behind a server endpoint (serverless function) holding the key; client calls the proxy. Until then, restrict key by HTTP referrer and quota.
human_reason: Requires a backend/hosting decision and provisioning of a server-side secret.

title: Authentication is simulated: any identifier/password is accepted
impact: No access control exists; 'E2EE'/'Device trust' badges imply otherwise.
remediation: Introduce an auth service boundary (interface + stub) now; integrate a real IdP (OIDC/magic-link provider) before launch.
human_reason: Requires product decision on identity provider and a backend.

title: Remove misleading 'E2EE Active' / 'Device Trust Verified' security badges
impact: Deceptive security claims with no implementation behind them; trust/legal exposure.
exploit_or_repro: Render Gateway; badges are static JSX.
remediation: Replace with honest status text (e.g. 'Demo authentication — no server verification').

title: Third-party CDN script and importmap loaded without SRI; shipped in dist
impact: Compromise of cdn.tailwindcss.com or aistudiocdn.com yields arbitrary script execution in the app.
remediation: Remove test libs from importmap; plan migration of Tailwind to a build-time dependency; add CSP.

title: Cap and sanitise uploaded file content before interpolating into LLM prompt
impact: Arbitrary-size, attacker-controlled text is sent verbatim to the model: cost amplification and prompt-injection of the parser.
exploit_or_repro: Upload a multi-MB file -> whole content sent.
remediation: Enforce a size limit (e.g. 200 KB), reject binary, and fence the content in the prompt.

title: Node/role IDs derived from Date.now() collide on bulk import
impact: Two roles with the same name imported in the same millisecond get identical ids -> duplicate React keys, broken selection/deletion.
exploit_or_repro: Import a file yielding two 'Doctor' roles.
remediation: Use crypto.randomUUID() (or a monotonic counter) for ids.

title: No persistence layer: all state is in-memory React state
impact: Reload loses scenario and session; tournaments cannot change.
remediation: Add localStorage persistence for scenarios/registrations as an MVP step; document backend as follow-up.

title: Add CI, container/deploy manifest and .env.example (all absent)
impact: No automated build gate, no reproducible runtime artifact, no documented env contract.
remediation: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml (typecheck, test, build), multi-stage Dockerfile (nginx, non-root), .env.example.

title: Favicon link points to /vite.svg which does not exist
impact: 404 on every page load; log noise.
remediation: Add public/favicon.svg and update link.

title: Add a React ErrorBoundary; any render error white-screens the app
impact: Single component throw takes down the whole SPA with no user feedback.
remediation: Wrap <App/> in an ErrorBoundary with a recovery UI.

title: Gemini requests have no timeout/abort
impact: Hung network leaves spinner forever; no cancellation.
remediation: Pass an AbortSignal with a 30 s timeout via config.abortSignal.

title: Errors are surfaced only via console.error and window.alert
impact: No structured logs, no error tracking hook, blocking alerts in UI.
remediation: Add a tiny logger module and in-app notification banner; route all user-facing errors through it.

title: Single 668 kB JS chunk; 125 kB role dataset eagerly bundled
impact: Slow first paint on the login page for code the user may never open.
remediation: React.lazy the ScriptRiter scene (which pulls data/communityRoles.ts).

title: Validate AI/imported `team` against the Team enum before casting
impact: Unknown team strings bypass the switch in getTeamColor and corrupt scenario data; prompt lists 3 teams but enum has 4.
remediation: Add normaliseTeam() mapping unknown -> Team.INDEPENDENT with a warning; align prompt wording with enum.

title: Remove 18 orphan files incl. duplicated legacy components
impact: ~2,000 LOC of dead/duplicate code (components/{Dashboard,Header,TournamentBrowser,ScenarioEditor,AnimatedLogo}.tsx, components/icons/*, 3 ScenarioEditor copies) confuses maintenance.
remediation: Delete exact duplicates that have shared-ui counterparts; keep scene stubs.

title: Split god-files: ScriptRiterScene 757 LOC, ScenarioEditor 721/675 LOC
impact: High change risk; multiple components per file.
remediation: Extract RoleLibrary, Inspector, AIGenModal into separate files.

title: Move test libraries out of `dependencies` and the production importmap
impact: Test tooling is declared as a runtime dependency.
remediation: Move to devDependencies; drop from importmap.

title: Rewrite README (template boilerplate); add .env.example
impact: New engineer cannot learn features, scripts, or env contract.
remediation: Document product, journeys, scripts, env vars, limitations.

title: Add a LICENSE file (absent)
impact: Rights to use/redistribute are undefined; default all-rights-reserved.
remediation: Owner selects a licence.
human_reason: Licence choice is a legal/business decision.

title: Digital-ID login with a non-email identifier is blocked by hidden email input validation
impact: Clicking Authenticate with an Operator ID such as 'operator1' never submits: the hidden magic-link <input type=email> (value shared via `identifier` state, not disabled, form lacks noValidate) fails constraint validation and the browser suppresses the submit event with no visible feedback.
exploit_or_repro: render GatewayScene; type 'operator1' in Identifier; click Authenticate -> no alert, no loading (cmd#27). Repo test 'shows validation error for empty password in password mode' fails for this reason.
remediation: Add noValidate to the form (custom validation already exists) and disable inputs in inactive tab panels.
freeze_exception: FREEZE_EXCEPTION-001: discovered during T-001 verification (cmd#26/#27) after Phase 5 freeze; secondary validation = deterministic jsdom reproduction.
